positions.name: QuillmoorArchiveRetentionPolicy
positions.frame: how should archival retention differentiate between raw field recordings and permanent transcripts?
positions.why: Odette articulates the operational policy of purging raw audio after eighteen months while retaining transcripts indefinitely, which Linus explicitly confirms.
